title: Remember until worry leaves the body
summary: Repeated remembrance brings peace close enough for worry and anguish to loosen from the body.
takeaway: Repeat the Name until worry leaves the body.
lifeApplication: Before solving the whole future, repeat the Name slowly enough for your breath and shoulders to receive peace.

source.shortMeaning: Repeated remembrance brings peace, and worry and anguish begin to leave the body.
source.lifeApplication: Before panic grows legs, repeat the Name slowly enough to feel peace return to the body.

evidence.coreClaim: Repeated remembrance brings peace, and worry and anguish begin to leave the body.
evidence.turn: Carry remembrance into the body before worry settles there.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before solving the whole future, repeat the Name slowly enough for your breath and shoulders to receive peace.
